title: lathyrus spathulatus subsp. elongatus
intro: Lathyrus spathulatus subsp. elongatus, commonly known as the Elongated Pea, is a species of flowering plant in the pea family (Fabaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus spathulatus subsp. elongatus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the potential health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant.
